# eloquent-ddl-postgresql

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities mapped with Eloquent 12, repositories and services, in PHP 8.4. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: postgresql.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (readonly classes); updates take a Patch per field: absent, or a value that may be null.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/Database.php             the connection of DATABASE_URL, which the models use
src/UnitOfWork.php           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/Entities/                one entity per table
src/Repositories/            the repositories of each table
src/Services/                one service per table
tests/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json           what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
composer install
TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/app" vendor/bin/phpunit   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A page of a list: the rows from an offset, and how many there are in all.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Page
{
    /** @param list<T> $items */
    public function __construct(public array $items, public int $total, public int $offset, public int $limit)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The same page with every row turned into something else.
     *
     * @template R
     * @param callable(T): R $mapper
     * @return Page<R>
     */
    public function map(callable $mapper): self
    {
        return new self(array_map($mapper, $this->items), $this->total, $this->offset, $this->limit);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A field of an update: absent (it keeps its value), or present with a value, which may be null.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Patch
{
    /** An absent field; use Patch::of() for one with a value. */
    public function __construct(public bool $isPresent = false, public mixed $value = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The field keeps its value.
     *
     * @return Patch<mixed>
     */
    public static function absent(): self
    {
        return new self();
    }

    /**
     * The field takes this value, which may be null.
     *
     * @template V
     * @param V $value
     * @return Patch<V>
     */
    public static function of(mixed $value): self
    {
        return new self(true, $value);
    }
}

namespace App\Common;

/** New uuids, for the columns the database fills with one: not every database can, so they are made before the insert. */
final class Uuid
{
    /** A random uuid (version 4). */
    public static function v4(): string
    {
        $bytes = random_bytes(16);
        $bytes[6] = chr((ord($bytes[6]) & 0x0f) | 0x40);
        $bytes[8] = chr((ord($bytes[8]) & 0x3f) | 0x80);
        return vsprintf('%s%s-%s-%s-%s-%s%s%s', str_split(bin2hex($bytes), 4));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use Illuminate\Database\Capsule\Manager;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;

/** The database DATABASE_URL names, through Eloquent. It never migrates: the database already exists. */
final class Database
{
    public const DEFAULT_URL = 'postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/app';

    /** The URL of DATABASE_URL, or the default one. */
    public static function url(): string
    {
        $url = getenv('DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : self::DEFAULT_URL;
    }

    /** A connection to the database at $url (DATABASE_URL when null); the models use it from then on. */
    public static function open(?string $url = null): Connection
    {
        $capsule = new Manager();
        $capsule->addConnection(self::config($url ?? self::url()));
        $capsule->bootEloquent();
        return $capsule->getConnection();
    }

    /**
     * The settings of the connection to a URL: postgresql://, mysql://, mariadb:// or sqlite:///<path> (sqlite:///:memory: for one in memory).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function config(string $url): array
    {
        if (str_starts_with($url, 'sqlite:')) {
            $path = substr($url, strlen('sqlite:///'));
            return ['driver' => 'sqlite', 'database' => $path !== '' ? $path : ':memory:', 'foreign_key_constraints' => true];
        }
        return ['url' => $url];
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Database\Eloquent\CastsAttributes;

/**
 * An array of PostgreSQL ({a,b}) as a PHP array; its items are text, or of the type the cast names.
 *
 * @implements CastsAttributes<array<int, mixed>, array<int, mixed>>
 */
final class PgArray implements CastsAttributes
{
    public function __construct(private readonly string $item = 'string')
    {
    }

    public function get($model, string $key, mixed $value, array $attributes): ?array
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return null;
        }
        $at = 0;
        return $this->read((string) $value, $at);
    }

    public function set($model, string $key, mixed $value, array $attributes): ?string
    {
        return is_array($value) ? $this->write($value) : $value;
    }

    /** The array that starts at a position of the text, which is left after it. */
    private function read(string $text, int &$at): array
    {
        $items = [];
        $at++;
        while ($text[$at] !== '}') {
            if ($text[$at] === ',') {
                $at++;
            } elseif ($text[$at] === '{') {
                $items[] = $this->read($text, $at);
            } elseif ($text[$at] === '"') {
                $item = '';
                for ($at++; $text[$at] !== '"'; $at++) {
                    if ($text[$at] === '\\') {
                        $at++;
                    }
                    $item .= $text[$at];
                }
                $at++;
                $items[] = $this->item($item);
            } else {
                $length = strcspn($text, ',}', $at);
                $item = substr($text, $at, $length);
                $at += $length;
                $items[] = $item === 'NULL' ? null : $this->item($item);
            }
        }
        $at++;
        return $items;
    }

    private function item(string $text): int|float|bool|string
    {
        return match ($this->item) {
            'int' => (int) $text,
            'float' => (float) $text,
            'bool' => $text === 't',
            default => $text,
        };
    }

    private function write(array $items): string
    {
        $written = array_map(fn (mixed $item): string => match (true) {
            $item === null => 'NULL',
            is_array($item) => $this->write($item),
            is_bool($item) => $item ? 't' : 'f',
            default => '"' . addcslashes((string) $item, '"\\') . '"',
        }, $items);
        return '{' . implode(',', $written) . '}';
    }
}

/** Keeps empties rows in the database, through its Eloquent model and the query builder, by every column of its key. A write joins the transaction already open, or is committed at once. */
final class SqlEmptyEntityRepository implements EmptyEntityRepository
{
    public function findById(int $id): ?EmptyEntity
    {
        return EmptyEntity::query()
            ->where('id', $id)
            ->first();
    }

    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        $query = EmptyEntity::query();
        $total = (clone $query)->count();
        $items = $query
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->offset($offset)
            ->limit($limit)
            ->get()
            ->all();
        return new Page($items, $total, $offset, $limit);
    }

    public function insert(EmptyEntity $entity): EmptyEntity
    {
        $this->write(fn () => $entity->save());
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update(EmptyEntity $entity): EmptyEntity
    {
        $changes = $entity->getDirty();
        if ($changes !== []) {
            $this->write(fn () => EmptyEntity::query()
                ->where('id', $entity->getOriginal('id'))
                ->update($changes));
        }
        $entity->syncOriginal();
        return $entity;
    }

    public function delete(EmptyEntity $entity): void
    {
        $this->write(fn () => EmptyEntity::query()
            ->where('id', $entity->getOriginal('id'))
            ->delete());
        $entity->exists = false;
    }

    /** Runs a write; a database refusal (a unique value, a row still pointed to) becomes a ConflictException. */
    private function write(callable $change): void
    {
        try {
            $change();
        } catch (QueryException $error) {
            // SQLSTATE class 23: the change breaks a constraint
            if (!str_starts_with((string) $error->getCode(), '23')) {
                throw $error;
            }
            throw new ConflictException('EmptyEntity', 'the database refused the change: ' . $error->getMessage());
        }
    }
}

        $this->order = new SqlOrderRepository();
        $this->entries = new SqlEntryRepository();

    {

        if ($this->db->transactionLevel() > 0) {
            return $work($this);
        }
        return $this->db->transaction(fn () => $work($this));
    }

{
    public ThingRepository $things { get; }
    public KindRepository $kinds { get; }

}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\Database;
use App\SqlUnitOfWork;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Builder;

/** The test database: the PostgreSQL database TEST_DATABASE_URL names, with every table created empty for every test. */
final class TestDatabase
{
    public static function url(): ?string
    {
        $url = getenv('TEST_DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : null;
    }

    /** The repositories over the test database, with every table dropped and created again. */
    public static function open(): SqlUnitOfWork
    {
        // The tables are written for one kind of database: the tests cannot fall back to SQLite
        $db = Database::open(self::url() ?? throw new \RuntimeException('The database tests need a disposable PostgreSQL database: set TEST_DATABASE_URL (it is emptied)'));
        $schema = $db->getSchemaBuilder();
        $schema->dropAllTables();
        // The schemas the tables are in, emptied and created again
        $db->statement('DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS "audit" CASCADE');
        $db->statement('CREATE SCHEMA "audit"');
        $schema->dropAllTypes();
        $db->statement('CREATE TYPE "mood" AS ENUM (\'sad\', \'ok\', \'very happy\')');
        self::createTables($schema);
        return new SqlUnitOfWork($db);
    }

    /** Every table as the database has it, parents first. */
    private static function createTables(Builder $schema): void
    {
        $schema->create('things', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->uuid('id');
            $table->uuid('token');
            $table->smallInteger('small');
            $table->integer('num')->nullable();
            $table->bigInteger('big');
            $table->decimal('price', 10, 2);
            $table->float('r');
            $table->double('d')->nullable();
            $table->boolean('flag')->default(true);
            $table->date('born');
            $table->time('opens');
            $table->timeTz('opens_tz');
            $table->dateTime('at');
            $table->dateTimeTz('at_tz');
            $table->binary('bin');
            $table->jsonb('data');
            $table->json('plain')->nullable();
            $table->string('feeling');
            $table->rawColumn('tags', 'text[]');
            $table->rawColumn('numbers', 'integer[]')->nullable();
            $table->string('ip')->nullable();
            $table->string('span')->nullable();
            $table->char('code', 5);
            $table->text('note')->nullable();
            $table->dateTimeTz('changed')->nullable()->useCurrent();
            $table->decimal('total', 12, 2)->nullable()->storedAs('price * 2');
            $table->primary(['id']);
        });
        $schema->getConnection()->statement('ALTER TABLE "things" ALTER COLUMN "feeling" TYPE "mood" USING "feeling"::"mood"');

        $schema->create('kinds', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->string('code', 10);
            $table->date('day');
            $table->string('label', 30)->nullable();
            $table->primary(['code', 'day']);
        });

        $schema->create('Order', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->bigInteger('Id', true);
            $table->string('user', 40);
            $table->integer('group')->default(0);
            $table->string('customerName', 60);
            $table->text('class')->nullable();
            $table->text('metadata')->nullable();
            $table->date('date')->nullable();
            $table->time('time')->nullable();
            $table->string('text', 20)->nullable();
            $table->text('list')->nullable();
            $table->string('str', 10)->nullable();
            $table->integer('int')->nullable();
            $table->date('dueDate');
            $table->time('closesAt')->nullable();
            $table->dateTime('createdAt')->nullable()->useCurrent();
            $table->string('kind_code', 10)->nullable();
            $table->date('kind_day')->nullable();
            $table->uuid('thing_id')->nullable();
            $table->bigInteger('parentId')->nullable();
            $table->unique(['customerName']);
            $table->foreign(['thing_id'])->references(['id'])->on('things')->onDelete('set null');
            $table->foreign(['parentId'])->references(['Id'])->on('Order');
            $table->foreign(['kind_code', 'kind_day'])->references(['code', 'day'])->on('kinds');
            // CHECK ("group" >= 0): the schema builder has no CHECK constraints
        });

        $schema->create('audit.entries', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->integer('entry_no', true);
            $table->bigInteger('orderId');
            $table->string('message', 200);
            $table->foreign(['orderId'])->references(['Id'])->on('Order')->onDelete('cascade');
        });

        $schema->create('empties', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->bigInteger('id', true);
            $table->text('note')->nullable();
        });
    }
}

/** The repository of the "things" table, against the test database. */

{
    /** The repositories over the test database, opened empty for every test */
    private SqlUnitOfWork $uow;

    {
        $this->uow = TestDatabase::open();
    }

    {
        $this->uow->db->disconnect();
    }

    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $stored = Factories::addThing($uow, 1);
        $found = $uow->things->findById($stored->id);
        self::assertNotNull($found);
        self::assertEquals($stored->id, $found->id);
    }

    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        Factories::addThing($uow, 1);
        Factories::addThing($uow, 2);
        $page = $uow->things->list(0, 1);
        self::assertSame(2, $page->total);
        self::assertCount(1, $page->items);
    }

    {
        $uow = $this->uow;
        $stored = Factories::addThing($uow, 1);
        $stored->note = 'changed';
        $uow->things->update($stored);
        self::assertSame('changed', $uow->things->findById($stored->id)->note);
    }

    {

        $key0 = $stored->id;
        $uow->things->delete($stored);

    }
